combatAbilities.name: Vitality Momentum
combatAbilities.description: The first time you enter an enemy's reach each round, gain 1 Defence until that round ends.

combatSongs.name: Vitality Warcry Verse
combatSongs.description: The chosen target must be able to hear this Verse. Make a Song attack against one target within 5 spaces. On a hit, deal 1d8 + Resonance blood damage.

combatSongs.name: Nemesis Mark Unbroken Verse
combatSongs.description: The performer must be able to hear their own Verse. Gain temporary HP equal to 1d6 + Guard and advantage on your next melee attack this turn.

combatSongs.name: Bloody Bridge Marching Canticle
combatSongs.description: Every creature that can hear this Canticle is affected, including the performer, allies, and enemies. While this Canticle is active, each affected creature's first hit each round deals +1d4 blood damage.

combatSongs.name: Vitality Cataclysm Canticle
combatSongs.description: Every creature that can hear this Canticle is affected, including the performer, allies, and enemies. After one round of chanting, each affected creature within 3 spaces cannot take reactions and takes Resonance blood damage at the start of its turn for 3 rounds.

socialAbilities.name: Unrivaled Vitality
socialAbilities.description: Get rid of any external status (e.g poison, paralysis, etc).

socialAbilities.name: Bloody Bridge
socialAbilities.description: Use the blood of nearby corpses to built a temporary solid structure. Stays hardened for an hour.

socialAbilities.name: Blood Scent Ward
socialAbilities.description: Mask the scent of fresh kills or butchered carcasses so predators are less likely to gather.

socialAbilities.name: Scavenger Eye
socialAbilities.description: Briefly gain heightened vision for spotting dropped items or hidden remains in the wild.

socialAbilities.name: Mark Nemesis
socialAbilities.description: When your blood is on another creature you can mark them as your Nemesis. Any action you take towards each other you will be at an advantage, but they always know where you are - or vice versa. This mark cannot be undone by anything but death.

socialAbilities.name: Vitality Field Counsel
socialAbilities.description: Read the immediate environment and reveal one practical danger the group has overlooked. Its expression reflects vein-patterned wings that pulsate with life energy.

socialAbilities.name: Nemesis Mark Quiet Industry
socialAbilities.description: Complete a careful mundane task with supernatural steadiness and without drawing attention. Its expression reflects vein-patterned wings that pulsate with life energy.

socialAbilities.name: Bloody Bridge Memory Thread
socialAbilities.description: Preserve an exact sensory memory and replay its important details for the group. Its expression reflects vein-patterned wings that pulsate with life energy.

socialAbilities.name: Vitality Sheltered Passage
socialAbilities.description: Guide nearby companions through one environmental obstacle with reduced risk. Its expression reflects vein-patterned wings that pulsate with life energy.

socialAbilities.name: Nemesis Mark Private Signal
socialAbilities.description: Send a subtle, recognizable sign to one nearby ally without alerting casual observers. Its expression reflects vein-patterned wings that pulsate with life energy.

combatAbilities.name: Crimson Execution
combatAbilities.description: Attack one target for 1d10 + Finesse blood damage; deal +1d6 if it is Exposed.

combatAbilities.name: Bloodshadow Ambush
combatAbilities.description: Move 3 spaces, then attack with advantage for 2d8 blood damage.

combatAbilities.name: Occult Mark Feint
combatAbilities.description: One enemy makes a Focus saving throw against your Save Difficulty; on failure your next attack against it ignores reactions.

combatAbilities.name: Crimson Slip
combatAbilities.description: When targeted, move 1 space and impose disadvantage on the attack.

combatAbilities.name: Bloodshadow Predation
combatAbilities.description: Make three attacks against one target, each dealing 1d8 blood damage.

combatAbilities.name: Occult Mark Expose
combatAbilities.description: Deal 1d6 damage and make the target Exposed until an ally hits it.

combatAbilities.name: Crimson Vanish
combatAbilities.description: Become Hidden until you attack, cast, or end your turn in clear sight.

combatAbilities.name: Bloodshadow Riposte
combatAbilities.description: After an enemy misses you, immediately deal 1d10 + Finesse blood damage to it.

combatAbilities.name: Occult Mark Final Quiet
combatAbilities.description: Attack for 5d8 blood; roll with advantage if no enemy is adjacent to the target.

combatAbilities.name: Crimson Opening
combatAbilities.description: Once per round, deal +Tempo damage to a target that has not acted this round.

combatSongs.name: Crimson Killing Verse
combatSongs.description: The chosen target must be able to hear this Verse. Make a Song attack against one target within 6 spaces. On a hit, deal 1d10 + Resonance blood damage.

combatSongs.name: Bloodshadow Opening Verse
combatSongs.description: The chosen target must be able to hear this Verse. One target within 6 spaces makes a Focus saving throw against your Save Difficulty, becoming Exposed on failure.

combatSongs.name: Occult Mark Predator Canticle
combatSongs.description: Every creature that can hear this Canticle is affected, including the performer, allies, and enemies. While this Canticle is active, each affected creature's first hit against an Exposed target each round deals +1d6 blood damage.

combatSongs.name: Crimson Final Quiet Canticle
combatSongs.description: Every creature that can hear this Canticle is affected, including the performer, allies, and enemies. After one round of chanting, each affected creature scores a critical hit on 19 or 20 with its attacks for 3 rounds.

socialAbilities.name: Occultation Mark
socialAbilities.description: Place a faint sigil on your own hide or clothing, preventing mild curses from latching onto you. Stays active for 1 hour.

socialAbilities.name: Shadow Crafter
socialAbilities.description: You can work any crafting method without being able to see for 1 creation.

socialAbilities.name: Blood Purification
socialAbilities.description: Burn any foreign substance from a collection of blood.

socialAbilities.name: Blood Attunement
socialAbilities.description: In a brief ritual, sense faint leftover emotions in spilled blood, gleaning hints about the event’s mood.

socialAbilities.name: Crimson Douse
socialAbilities.description: Easily extinguish fire with the use of nearby blood
